text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While stopping by the mall and
enjoying some shopping with Almond Eye—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. That looks nice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, where she dashed off to was—the cleaning supplies aisle at the drugstore.
choice_data_list: Are you gonna clean your room or something?
Are you going to clean your room or something?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this? Well,
Hishi Ama-san this morning, you see—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The Miho Dorm Cleaning Day is coming up soon, but do we really not have enough detergent and rags at this rate?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "I have to go out today and tomorrow... Hmm, when should I go buy it...?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that does it. With this much,
Hishi Ama-san won't have to worry!
choice_data_list: That's thoughtful of you.
How thoughtful of you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dorm life is all about helping each other out.
Besides, this is a cleaning "competition", after all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
After distributing the cleaning supplies equally to everyone,
I will clean the dorm better than anyone else.
That's how it should be.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. The crepes from this shop look delicious, don't they?
choice_data_list: Wanna grab a bite before we go?
Want to grab a bite?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Wait a sec.
I ran for an hour this morning...
and my step count since heading out is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! If it's just a crepe,
it's well within my calorie limit.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Shall we drop by, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~
Here are your cappuccino and crepes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Please set the cappuccino over there.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, what's the matter?
You're staring at me."
choice_data_list: No... I was just thinking how reliable you are.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
? Thank you.
...But why?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm merely doing what I always do.
So that I can be satisfied with myself, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—after this was supposed to be today's main event,
going to see a movie, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Road construction?!
And there's barely any time left until the movie starts...
choice_data_list: I might have to be prepared to be a little late...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......
Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. It'll be a bit of a detour, but we might just make it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Follow me.
Take my hand so we don't get separated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pulling me by the hand, Almond Eye darted into a side alley!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Just over three minutes left...
Alright, I should be able to make it in time somehow!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, I might be getting a little tired...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: In that case... A piggyback ride! I'll give you one!
choice_data_list: N-No, that's—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy.
...Or are you feeling embarrassed?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! There aren't many people on this path, 
so we'll get there in no time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—somehow, we made it in time for the screening.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~! That was so fun!
I'm glad we didn't miss
the opening video either.
choice_data_list: It's thanks to you.
It's thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you're making a big deal out of nothing. I just
didn't want anything to ruin a day like today."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Since it's my day off with you, after all. I have to make it a completely perfect day—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Today will just end up being a 'loss.'
Don't you think so?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her, something came back to mind.
Today was a day where I saw a lot of Almond Eye's
'reliable' side, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
After distributing the cleaning supplies equally to everyone,
I will clean the dorm better than anyone else.
That's how it should be.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm merely doing what I always do.
So that I can be satisfied with myself, you see.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Staring at me again.
Could it be you're going to praise me some more?
choice_data_list: You really are growing through these daily "matches."
You really are growing through these daily "matches."
...I need to pull myself together more too.
...I need to pull myself together more, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Staring at me again.
Could it be you're going to praise me some more?
choice_data_list: You really are growing through these daily "matches."
You really are growing through these daily "matches."
...I need to pull myself together more too.
...I need to pull myself together more, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I guess... so.
Yeah, I suppose there might be some truth to that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've always kept daily notes on "How much I won today!"
Ever since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...So that's how it is. Today gave me
a clear look at the core mindset
behind Almond Eye's reliability."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
My, what determined eyes you have.
Are you reaffirming your resolve?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then I too—will make sure not to miss
a single moment of your "dependability." Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“An ‘utter hatred of losing’—or perhaps,
a ‘tireless drive to grow’.
It was a day that laid Almond Eye's values bare.”
